decisions.reason: The broader metric filling interface needs a definition of the global coarse isoperimetric function. This supplier pair exports the required finite-presentation specialization and the square-root inequality; the general formulation is not assumed.
decisions.evidence: Step-8 current-closure review: read Drutu–Kapovich Theorem 11.181 and its complete proof (PDF index451), relating a global subquadratic coarse isoperimetric function on a coarsely simply-connected geodesic space to hyperbolicity. The owned square-root-minsize lemma assumes a specified finite coarse filling. thm-linear-relator-area-implies-slim-geodesic-triangles combines explicit finite-presentation fillings with N<=C(L)(K+2)(P+7) and derives A sqrt(P+7)+B, then the local sublinear criterion. It asserts no global coarse isoperimetric function or general subquadratic theorem. The HG-P binding inventory commissions this specialization; quantitative-hyperbolic-geometry-toolkit is a valid retained, unbuilt later destination at 302.0042 requiring HG-P. Its planned quantitative/filling scope is compatible with the deferral, but this decision does not claim the broader theorem is already a mandatory item there. No current proof needs it.

decisions.name: Conjugator length bounded by diagram diameter
decisions.reason: The coarse triangle estimate is controlled by relator perimeter and face/boundary incidence, not conjugator lengths or diagram diameter. This extra bound has no use in the assigned proof route.
decisions.evidence: Step-8 current-closure review: Bridson Proposition 4.1.2 bounds conjugators by pointed diagram diameter using a geodesic spanning tree; its full peeling proof was read. In contrast, current controlled-diagram construction counts occupied face incidences <=Lm and boundary-only bridges (twice on the exterior) to get edges <=Lm+|w|. The subsequent thickening and coarse-square-root bound depend only on these finite counts, relator perimeter L and literal boundary length; the final A,B depend only on K,L. No bound on conjugator length or diagram diameter is asserted or consumed. This extra source conclusion is outside the HG-P contract.
